contract.scope: Automatic adaptation; native replay is unchanged unless explicitly remixed

performance.note: Relative CPU budgets are frozen against the same-host baseline; real-device acceptance remains separate

contract.musicalAcceptance: Source dynamics and intended foreground retained; blind listening and held-out acoustic diagnostics reported separately from correctness. Thresholds cannot be fitted on held-out songs.
contract.prohibition: No song title, ID, source hash or held-out seed in the runtime policy

scope: Deterministic correctness and descriptive acoustics; no universal musical score or human preference claim
